== legacy: no stdin, no event (old installs: agent-finished with empty body)
legacy-empty|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-finished {}
== unknown event
unknown|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-finished {}
== SessionStart
start|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app","status":"working"}
== UserPromptSubmit
prompt|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app","status":"working"}
== Notification keeps the message, whitespace flattened
notify|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app","status":"waiting","message":"Needs your permission"}
== Stop
stop|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-finished {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app"}
== Stop without session id
stop-nosid|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-finished {}
== SessionEnd
end|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app","status":"finished"}
== quotes and backslashes are escaped
escape|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s\"1","tool":"claude-code","project":"my app","status":"waiting","message":"say \"hi\" \\ bye"}
== invalid JSON behaves like the legacy call
badjson|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-finished {}
== message longer than 200 chars is cut
longmsg|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"x","status":"waiting","mess
== sed fallback parser (no python3, no jq) gives the same requests
sedparse|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-status {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app","status":"waiting","message":"Needs your permission"}
sedparse|DRY-RUN POST /v1/hooks/agent-finished {"agent_id":"s1","tool":"claude-code","project":"app"}
== silent without a token
== always exit 0
exit|exit=0
